Scene 40002 / 汐見蛍 Hotaru Shiomi / 始まる、その前に
Page: https://ournotes.stonebg.cn/jp/zh-CN/immersive/40002/
Resource root: https://ournotes.stonebg.cn/content/releases/c0f670d94a125cc55d5b247c/public/immersive/scene-40002-v1/
Original game Spine home_start animation, duration 4 seconds.
Hotaru click callback ID: 16 (number).

Bundled renderer:
https://ournotes.stonebg.cn/app/releases/a75f978b6acdefaadc1cf8ef/chunks/immersive-renderer-N6QQMW2Y.js
One adjacent dependency:
https://ournotes.stonebg.cn/app/releases/a75f978b6acdefaadc1cf8ef/chunks/chunk-EOUF7VOX.js

Profiles copied as data from source controller:
https://ournotes.stonebg.cn/app/releases/a75f978b6acdefaadc1cf8ef/scripts/script-39-6PU2F7MR.js

The custom garage-loader.js handles local file references, loading progress,
camera profiles, original character hit regions, looping, and pause/dispose.
Import loadOriginalGarage(container, 40001 or 40002, options).
Container requires nonzero width and height. Renderer returns a canvas viewer.
Use viewer.setPaused(true) while hidden; false resumes. dispose() frees WebGL.
The loader repeats the original home_start sequence after a 1.8-second rest.
Use loop:false if the scene should play once, as in the archive viewer.

Underlying dependencies include Three.js and Esoteric Software Spine Runtimes.
Keep their corresponding license files and the Otonote license with distribution.
Spine license source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes/4.2/LICENSE

Research date: 2026-10-22. Assets were visually checked against the public scene
posters; original skeleton files identify Spine 4.2.40 and home_start animation.
Browser rendering and integration need verification by the owning site task.
